comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the report and especially for the .rdp file, which made the cause visible straight away.

**What was wrong.** Importing an .rdp file ignored every authentication setting in it. Your file sets `enablerdsaadauth:i:1` (Entra ID sign-in), but the imported connection came in with Entra ID authentication turned off, so from a machine that is not Entra-joined it failed immediately. The importer now reads `enablerdsaadauth`, `redirectwebauthn`, `enablecredsspsupport` and `authentication le...

comments.author: GurliGebis
comments.snippet:
Does not work at all - if "Use CredSSP" is set to "No", it gets rejected immediately (due to NLA failing).
If it is set to "Yes", it shows the Windows credentials dialog box, which is wrong, since it should show a web window, allowing me to log in using the Azure portal login page.

I think this needs some more integration than just making sure the correct parameters are sent, since it needs to spawn the web page, capture the token etc.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for retesting. Your result shows that fixing the import did not resolve the web sign-in you reported: CredSSP off is rejected, and on brings up the wrong dialog.
We are keeping this open and will investigate the embedded RDP control's sign-in path against the working mstsc case you already supplied.
The current code requests Entra authentication but can silently ignore one unsupported-property error; that is a lead to check, not a confirmed explanation.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Closing — unanswered.

On 29 September we published a diagnostic build and asked for the two `RDP authentication setting` lines from one connection attempt. There has been no reply for eight days. Checked so far: the .rdp import now carries `enablerdsaadauth`, and the embedded control accepts `EnableRdsAadAuth` but rejects `RedirectWebAuthn` (0x8000FFFF). Entra web sign-in itself has not been verified, because we have no matching Entra target.

This close is not a finding that the sign-in works....

notes: 2026-10-02: diagnostic ask of 29 Sep is inside the seven-day window. Close unanswered on 6 Oct if it is still the latest word.
